name: slackLists.items.list

limit.desc: The maximum number of records to return.

archived.desc: Boolean indicating whether archived items or normal items should be returned.

include_list.desc: Set to true to also return the parent list object, including its title, column schema, and total row count. Defaults to false to keep the response small.
